records.title: PLAN Submarine Operations, Far-Seas SSBN Crew Rotation Models & Indian Ocean Basing Analysis (CMSI-60, CMSI-68, CMSI-69)
records.author_org: PLAN Submarine Academy (Qingdao), Eastern Theater Navy Submarine Flotilla (Navy Today), & Modern Ships (CSIC 714 Institute)
records.type: Submarine Operational Doctrine, Mathematical Presence Models & Overseas Basing Analysis
records.description: Covers Eastern Theater Command Navy Type 039A/B AIP submarine unscripted combat readiness patrols and thermocline ('sea cliff') recovery (CMSI-60); the PLAN Submarine Academy's mathematical model of SSBN Base Rotation vs. Far Seas Rotation (Tables 1 & 2 in CMSI-68, showing a +18.63 percentage-point gain in at-sea presence at 17 days transit by using refitted LPDs/support ships and blue-green laser/neutrino/quantum comms); and 'Hei Jin's' analysis of Malacca/Sunda wartime ASW bottlenecks, Djibouti's <10 km proximity to U.S. Camp Lemonnier and P-3C optical exposure, and proposed 'second-tier' Indian Ocean submarine basing in Tanzania or Madagascar (CMSI-69).
records.use_description: The papers distinguish published sources from the authors’ modeling assumptions in their analysis of naval policy.

records.title: PLAN Warship Survivability, Damage Control Equipment Optimization & Quantitative Damage Control Plan Methodology (CMSI-60, CMSI-61, CMSI-62)
records.author_org: PLA Unit 92692 (Southern Theater Navy 6th Landing Ship Flotilla, Zhanjiang) & PLA Unit 91999 (Northern Theater Navy Salvage & Rescue Flotilla, Qingdao)
records.type: Warship Damage Control Engineering & Readiness Studies
records.description: Synthesizes frontline PLAN damage control audits: pier joint inspection group drill logs (CMSI-60); PLA Unit 92692's critique of random stowage overflow, split Navigation Support vs. Equipment Department management, incompatible 6-kg CO2 fire extinguisher frames (Zhejiang vs. Qingdao factories), and pre-connected wall-mounted fire hoses cutting water deployment time by two-thirds to 10 seconds (CMSI-61); and PLA Unit 91999's critique of ships copying damage control plans behind closed doors to pass inspections, CO 'luck mentality', weapon blast radii (≥5m underwater, ≥2m missile), and aft engine room flooding-time Formula 1 / Table 1 (43s at 200cm breach vs. 16,750s at 10cm, CMSI-62).
records.use_description: The papers cite Chinese technical literature to describe publication themes and institutional responsibilities.
